mechanics.validation: Connected jump/body-push lifecycle retains beta interior, wall, vertical, Width and air contact observations. Added PosFreeze on either root, then both, with mixed 320p/1280p coordinates. At stored VelX 2, beta positions are no-freeze(-6,26), first frozen(-7,25), second frozen(-5,27), both frozen(-6,26); velocities 2/2 and CNS times 350/350 continue. PosFreeze suppresses ordinary velocity movement, not late body separation. Scenario also checks release, real Pause and round reset clearing velocity/freeze state. Four changed-source segments pass with race detection; native scratch removed.

mechanics.name: Helper creation, identity, retirement and round cleanup
Targets and parent/root/target binding
mechanics.validation: Connected mixed-coordinate entity lifecycle covers moving-owner self binding, cumulative Pause allowances, bound body contact, retirement and reset. Asymmetric throw (pausetime 8,2) matches beta at elapsed passes 3/7/10: (attacker Time,target Time,target VelX,deltaX)=(0,3,0,30)/(0,7,0,30)/(2,10,0,26). A hit-paused anchor places targets but transfers zero velocity; expiry does not start victim drift. Scenario ends with own-state recovery/control and fresh helper identities/budgets after reset. Changed-source segments pass with race detection; native scratch removed. Other binding/pause combinations remain unverified.

mechanics.validation: Stock input/contact/recovery and complete match flows pass. A bounded original-beta projectile/direct/helper corner-contact flow confirms the existing projectile exclusion: explicit -12 leaves the owner at 0; direct/helper attackers move 130 to approximately 93.294, with receiver life990/980/970. Corrected the old missing-owner-path note; no owner-recoil behavior was added.

Other rendering combinations remain unverified; current scratch removed.

mechanics.name: Storyboard loading, playback and canvas scaling
mechanics.validation: Connected asset lifecycle spans a partially opaque colored fade, animated/text/sound scene, clearcolor=-1 scene transition and blank ticks retaining prior pixels, repeated presentation without re-blending, explicit clear replacement and exit. Content composes once per simulation tick; fade RGB is premultiplied and one reusable texel replaces full-canvas allocations. Match-flow passes with race detection. Linux rebuilt and owned-window KO/rematch/KO inspected; scratch removed.

mechanics.name: Background music and NoMusic integration
mechanics.validation: BGM decodes bounded blocks while position counts consumed samples. One connected lifecycle spans menu continuity, one-shot expiry, loop edges, NoMusic, SFX separation, round/scene clearing, rematch, streamed/resampled PCM24, extensible float WAV replacement and malformed-file recovery. Native Linux codecs reuse PCM buffers. The affected effects-pause/match-flow segments pass with race detection. Rebuilt Linux KO/rematch/KO played authored float WAV through the real device; all captures/PCM/overlays removed.

mechanics.name: Complete font, media and asset compatibility
mechanics.gap: Physical CD (.da) playback remains unavailable. ZIP character packs, streamed integer/float WAV and other file music, fonts, storyboard/AIR consumers and legacy ACT outfits/portraits work for the connected scenarios. Missing licensed fonts use a reported fallback; legacy-font native equivalence, native asset-rejection and exact raster parity remain unproven.
mechanics.validation: Connected asset flow covers V1 commented font settings/maps, padded PCX rows, font bank changes across retained scenes, packed sprite failure/correction, outfits and round reset. PCX retains one decoded plane; V1 shares the V2 total pixel budget, charging linked sources once. Existing SFF/font regressions and affected match-flow pass with race detection; other segments stay checked. Rebuilt Linux displays both authored font banks with expected pixel colors. The beta displayed the scene background but no authored glyphs, so this case does not establish native font equivalence. All current native/app scratch was removed.

mechanics.name: Remaining native rendering, audio and AI fidelity
mechanics.gap: Moving-zoom return precision (observed camera X difference about 0.15 pixels), other pause/hitpause and binding combinations, crop/raster edges, color/shadow/alpha, KO-echo playback and AI-policy precision remain open. Five sampled camera/zoom points through spread, translation, closing and stage-bound travel match the beta; the subsequent return is functional but not exact. Strict native asset rejection remains unverified.
mechanics.validation: One supplied-beta scene establishes PNG32/raw RGBA mask=0 opacity after byte-truncated premultiplication, mask=1 source alpha and fractional true-color BG filtering. The connected loader/draw/mask/visibility/reset scenario and Linux application reproduce 40 fixed native RGB samples without changing expectations. The initial one-shade upload mismatch was corrected at every SFF upload consumer. Other rendering, camera, binding, audio and AI precision listed in the gap remain open.

mechanics.name: Opponent AI and authored CMD command flow
mechanics.validation: A bounded beta input flow confirms x=a, a= makes authored x read physical a while logical a is disabled; physical x triggers neither. Connected command lifecycle covers shared-input chords, charge/motion/strict taps, remapped Start/charged release on root and key-controlled helper, then remapped stock AI attack/special/contact. AI translates logical plans back to physical inputs and skips unreachable disabled commands. Four affected segments pass with race detection; native scratch removed. Exact native AI policy remains open.

Ordinary KO-echo application capture differed by one extracted quiet interval; existing state/PCM observations do not establish the playback cause.
Turns, mixed-team and Survival recovery are calibrated against bounded beta flows. AI command selection is functional; native decision probabilities remain unverified.

Bounded camera/body-push/binding lifecycles are covered. Moving zoom matches five sampled beta points; return at state time 120 differs by about 0.15 pixels and remains open. Other pause/hitpause, binding and crop/raster precision remain unverified. Projectile contacts intentionally do not recoil the owner.

RGBA mask views, byte-truncated uploads and linear true-color background filtering match 40 fixed samples in one beta/Linux scene. This does not establish whole-frame or arbitrary alpha/palette/filtering parity.
